description.zh: 直播流所属应用名称。支持通配符*，代表该域名下所有的AppName。
description.en: The application name. You can use a wildcard character (\*) to represent all applications under the domain name.

description.zh: 直播流流名称。支持通配符*，代表该AppName下所有的StreamName。
description.en: The stream name. You can use a wildcard character (\*) to represent all streams under the application.

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为60次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: The number of queries per second (QPS) for this operation is limited to 60 per user. Calls that exceed this limit are throttled. This may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-delay-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain example.com --app liveApp0000 --stream liveStream0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveDelayConfig --region cn-hangzhou --App liveApp0000 --Stream liveStream0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain 'example.com'
